title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named student study and lounge spaces documented by Nazareth, with locations and listed access windows to help plan a focused break between classes.

cards.title: Pool Overlook
cards.subtitle: Otto A. Shults Center · main floor, overlooking the pool
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or reading assignment to the main-floor overlook, then use the view over the pool as a change-of-scene break.
cards.short_summary: A main-floor Shults Center study perch overlooking the campus pool.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists the Pool Overlook on the Shults Center main floor as a student space available 7 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth lists this space as open 7 a.m.–midnight; confirm access during building closures or special events.

cards.title: Commuter & Transfer Lounge
cards.subtitle: Otto A. Shults Center · Room 202, above Pool Overlook
cards.notes: Use the seating, computers, and TV in Room 202 when you need a campus base between classes or a place to reset.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs Shults Center lounge with seating and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth identifies the Commuter & Transfer Lounge in Shults Center Room 202 and lists it among spaces open 7 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth describes comfortable seating, computers, and a TV; its student-spaces guide lists 7 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Reading Lounge
cards.subtitle: Otto A. Shults Center · left of the Forum
cards.notes: Set up with a book or quiet task to the left of the Forum, and keep your group conversation low-key around nearby users.
cards.short_summary: A Shults Center reading area beside the Forum.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists the Reading Lounge to the left of the Forum as a student space available 7 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth lists this space as open 7 a.m.–midnight; confirm access during building closures or special events.

cards.title: 1924 Room
cards.subtitle: Otto A. Shults Center · Room 200, above Reading Lounge
cards.notes: Head upstairs above the Reading Lounge when you want a named room for a longer study block before returning to campus activities.
cards.short_summary: A named Room 200 study space above Shults Center’s Reading Lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists the “1924 Room” in Shults Center Room 200, above the Reading Lounge, as open 7 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth lists this space as open 7 a.m.–midnight; confirm access during building closures or special events.

cards.title: Porthole Lounge
cards.subtitle: Otto A. Shults Center · Room 110
cards.notes: Check whether Room 110 is available before settling in, then use the Porthole Lounge for an informal work session or a quiet pause.
cards.short_summary: A Shults Center lounge whose availability is noted as variable.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Porthole Lounge in Shults Center Room 110 as a student space open 7 a.m.–midnight when available.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth lists 7 a.m.–midnight when available; room use may change for other campus needs.

cards.title: Lorette Wilmot Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library · main level (second floor)
cards.notes: Use the main-level Reading Room for a library-based study stop, then consult the Information Desk if you need help locating materials.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room on the library’s main level.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth’s library map lists the Reading Room on the main level, along with stacks, group study rooms, and the Information Desk.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library main level; check current library building access and service hours before visiting.

cards.title: Lorette Wilmot Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: Lorette Wilmot Library · lower level (first floor)
cards.notes: Start at the lower-level Makerspace when a class project needs hands-on making, and ask library staff about current equipment or procedures.
cards.short_summary: A library lower-level space for hands-on project work.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth’s library map lists the Makerspace on the lower level of Lorette Wilmot Library.
cards.access_notes: Located on the library lower level; verify current library access and any equipment requirements before use.

cards.title: The Zen Den
cards.subtitle: Golisano Academic Center · Room 61B
cards.notes: Use Room 61B for a daytime focused session, and plan around the posted weekday window rather than assuming evening availability.
cards.short_summary: A named Golisano Academic Center study space with weekday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists The Zen Den in Golisano Academic Center Room 61B, open Monday–Friday from 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth lists Monday–Friday hours of 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; it follows Testing Center hours.

cards.title: Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Golisano Academic Center · Room 101
cards.notes: Step into Room 101 for a short quiet reset before class, keeping the space calm and leaving time for others to use it.
cards.short_summary: A named Golisano Academic Center room for quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists the Meditation Room in Golisano Academic Center Room 101 as a student space available 7 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth lists Golisano Academic Center student spaces as open 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; confirm holiday access.

cards.title: School of Education Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Golisano Academic Center · Room 203
cards.notes: Use Room 203 to work between classes or meet classmates, while respecting any department programming or room-use notices posted nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named Golisano Academic Center student lounge in Room 203.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists the School of Education Student Lounge in Golisano Academic Center Room 203 as a student space available 7 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Nazareth lists Golisano Academic Center student spaces as open 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; confirm holiday access.
